query:
select
  (select schedule from cron.job where jobname = 'survival-checkpoint') as cron_schedule,
  (select coalesce(string_agg(indexname, ', '), '(none)') from pg_indexes
   where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'notifications' and indexname like 'notifications_%uniq') as dedupe_indexes,
  (select conname from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.notifications'::regclass and conname = 'notifications_type_check') as type_check_ok,
  (select prosrc like '%followed_post_survived%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
   where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'run_survival_checkpoint') as fanout_in_checkpoint,
  (select prosrc like '%on conflict (post_id) where type = %like%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace
   where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'notify_on_like') as like_upsert_ok,
  (select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name='notifications' and column_name='extra_count') as extra_count_col;
